content: Fluorine is in at the right position, and SA is still fine at 1.81. QED is unchanged at 0.772 though, and the reason is the benzoyl: at 308 Da with LogP 3.61 and three aromatic rings, that phenyl is what keeps drug-likeness down. My leader uses a plain acetyl there, and the measured difference between acetyl and benzoyl in this series was only about 0.03 of jnk3 against roughly 0.07 of QED - a losing trade. Atom 1 is the amide carbonyl and atom 17 is the ipso carbon of the benzoyl phenyl, a non-ring bond, so I replace that whole ring with a methyl. The product is N-[3-fluoro-4-(pyrimidin-2-ylamino)phenyl]acetamide at ~246 Da: two aromatic rings, LogP near 2.1, TPSA 67, 3 rotatable bonds. It is the exact pyrimidine counterpart of my fluorinated pyridine leader, so the pair finally separates the halogen contribution from the azine contribution.
